notes.title: Development News | Overhaul Progress Update
notes.content:
It's coming together! We're getting closer and closer to the release of the Hammerheart Overhaul. I've grinning from ear-to-ear playtesting it, and I'm very excited to get it into your hands. It's going to be far more rich in features than the Hammerheart you know, but the nail-biting stress, party building aspect, and blend of fighting and tactics is all still there. It feels like Hammerheart.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41069425/82f51a829740a5d7c8929c6de0fbb0cc324934dc.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41069425/0adbeef499ed770f9398eb2c305a9d352b6a6945.png

The overhaul will release for free to all players once its stage of competion matches Hammerheart's current state. The game will then remain in early access, and it'll be continually updated until full release.

notes.title: Development News | Overhaul Progress Update
notes.content:
Some major milestones have been hit in the development of the Hammerheart Overhaul, and it's almost ready to be put into the hands of players for testing. Those of you that are following the Trello board will know that the fighting and command mode have been completed, each with an expanded and more refined featureset than they have in the current version of Hammerheart.

[previewyoutube=DI87Pu965_M;full][/previewyoutube]
The weapon types have all been made and animated, and thanks to the physics-based hit detection the different weapon types feel very distinct to one another and there are different skills to using them. In the future there are going to be different weapons within each type with cosmetic and statistical differences (ie Gilded Type S Sword, Inlaid Type G Winged Spear), but the main weapon types are as follows:


 Spears (Stabbing)
 Long Spears (Stabbing, two-handed only, penetrates mail)
 Javelins (Projectile, knocks shields, penetrates mail)
 Swords (Cutting or stabbing)
 Axes (Cutting, knocks shields)
 Long Axes (Cutting, two-handed only, knocks shields, penetrates mail)
 Seaxes (Stabbing)
 Langseaxes (Stabbing, penetrates mail)
 Bows (Projectile)

Other character options that affect fighting are:


 Height (Affects exposed target areas)
 Dominant hand (Affects all combat animations and footing, thus changing the exposed target areas)
 Helmets (Various shapes and sizes, covered part of head is immune to all weapons)
 Mail (Covered part of body is immune to most weapons)
 Shields (Various sizes, immune to all weapons but can be knocked out of the character's hand)

The overhaul will also grant players the much-requested ability to pick any weapon or shield up from the ground. Friendly AI characters will also pick up their weapons and shields if they've dropped or thrown them, given it's safe to do so. Both the fighting and command aspects of the overhaul have much more depth than their counterparts in the current version of Hammerheart.

The implementation of character customization is also complete:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41069425/9b19b56ac35d2213423725a67a050f294f908f44.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41069425/ee8362e3690e0b7a47d39fd0352bc10b89bc7e37.png

As are the graphics and control settings:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41069425/8b5972200dc9813b7e52fb44e534a65edc109242.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41069425/fedb409f0a8d262426a084d85aab5924b83a5eeb.png

So, what's next? I'm committed to a hard release of the Hammerheart Overhaul, but it's very important that it's tested and iterated on as early as possible so that the release goes as smoothly as possible. With this in mind, I will soon be releasing a test branch that any owners of Hammerheart can play, which will be constantly updated with the latest version of the Hammerheart Overhaul as it progresses. When it's complete, the test branch will be removed and the Hammerheart Overhaul will replace the current version Hammerheart as the main download. There are a few more features that need to be complete before the early version is released on the test branch:


 Encounter progression
 Inventory / encounter rewards system
 Out-of-encounter loadout and party management
 Basic map generation

I'm aiming to have these features complete this month, and when they're done the test branch will be made available to all owners of Hammerheart. I'm very excited to hear your feedback, and as always I'm more than happy to answer any questions you may have.

notes.title: Early Access Build 22.04.25.1
notes.content:
An important fix has been implemented that solves a game-breaking bug which has been occuring on some people's systems as of the last update.

Changes in build 21.12.17.1:


Fixed game-breaking bug which caused the game to freeze when trying to open certain UI menus.

If you encounter any bugs big or small during your time playing Hammerheart, please report them via the feedback channel in the official discord here. Work also continues on the Hammerheart total overhaul, the most ambitious update yet. Coming soon for free to all players, read more about it in this post.

notes.title: Early Access Build 21.12.17.1
notes.content:
The latest Hammerheart build is here, and contains the first features of some upcoming overhauls that will fundamentally change the game loop and offer players more freedom in every run.

Changes in build 21.12.17.1:


Fixed bug which caused Hakon and Wiglaf to kill the enemy in the tutorial.
Reduced default freedom of movement for troops upon starting an encounter to reduce UI clutter for new players.
Added red indicators that show when enemies are approaching from offscreen. These compliment the directional horn sounds to give players a better idea of how to assemble their troops.
Reworked weapon dropping: Instead of being automatically requipped in the next encounter, dropped weapons are now added to the inventory for a clearer and more intuitive inventory experience. This does not apply to thrown weapons.
Added UI notification for dropped weapons.
Added perk: Crampons - Allows the entire party to walk normally across all terrain.
Doubled lifespan of dropped loot.
Reset demo timers.

Welcome to all the new players who have joined since SplatterCatGaming's video. It's an honour to have you on board to experience how the game progresses.

notes.title: Development News | Early Access Build 21.10.26.1
notes.content:
Early Access Build 21.10.26.1 is here! This build includes the foundations of an important AI overhaul which will, in the future, allow for much more varied enemy types as well as give enemies the potential to make more effective use of upcoming unique weapon types. A simple new enemy type has arrived which targets the player specifically, while maintaining awareness of other threats. 

Changes in build 21.10.26.1:


New aggressive enemy type added that targets the player specifically. This enemy wears mail, a helmet and a cloak for easy identification.
Changed Snorri's behaviour to aggressive.
Added at least one aggressive enemy to each wave of the boss room.
Added new perk: Holy Water - Instantly heals all injuries in your party.
Enemy armour now deflects attacks in the same way as friendly armour does, instead of providing a stat bonus.
Added an additional perk selection opportunity after the first four encounters.
Fixed a bug which caused fewer perk options to show if the first perk selected was Ironside.

Special thanks to everyone who has joined since the last update! The Norway expansion is still in the works, but instead of waiting for an extended period of time to release it, we have decided to go back to small updates being published regularly while work continues on the new map. We hope you are happy with this decision, and as always we are happy to hear your feedback on the Hammerheart Discord server.

notes.title: Demo Release | Early Access Build 21.09.28.1
notes.content:
Want to try the game for free? Hammerheart now has a Demo! You can download it and play 20 minutes for free by pressing the "Download Demo" button on the store page.

Preparations for the upcoming Norway expansion are well underway. To compliment the new area coming soon, some important additions have been made in today's update.

Changes in build 21.09.28.1:


Completely remade perk selection UI at the start of the game.
Added "Eyvind" encounters that allow the player to choose an additional perk midway through a run
Approximately doubled the length of a run, and adjusted the difficulty curve with the later half of encounters now being harder than before. 
Added new perk: Heightened Senses - Companions using short arms have 360 degree awareness.
Added new perk: Grindstone - Bonus mellee backstab damage for all friendlies.
Added new perk: Bodkin Arrows - Bonus ranged backstab damage for all friendlies.
Added new perk: Linden - Player block rate has an increased effect on that of companions.
Added new perk: Reflexes - Companions using two-handed weapons will switch to their secondary if endangered.
Added new perk: Amber - One extra item rewarded after each encounter.
Added new perk: Highborn - Better starting equipment.
Renamed "Boss" encounter to "Snorri" in preparation for the next boss.
Added timer and expiry notification for the Demo build.

We're very excited about the future of Hammerheart. Much more coming soon!

notes.title: Minor Content Update 21.09.22.1
notes.content:
Some new features have arrived to Hammerheart, and many more are underway! Early Access build 21.09.22.1 aims to bring more strategic thinking into Hammerheart, both on an individual level and across the battlefield.

Changes in build 21.09.22.1:


Dropped enemy weapons now have a chance of being lootable. This applies both to dropped long weapons, and the weapon the enemy was wielding upon their death. Lootable weapons are highlighted in the colour of their tier (white, green, purple or gold) but will disappear after 10 seconds. If you're trying to bulk out your companions with basic weapons without rolling the weapon reward dice, this new feature will help you.
Movement speed now depends upon the environment; paths make you faster and mud makes you slower. Expansions upon this feature are planned to be added in future locations and with future mechanics.
Added passive blocking against arrows. If directly facing an archer, you do not need to raise your shield to block their arrows. However, a passively blocked arrow delivers twice the force of an actively blocked arrow. 
The correct block direction is now decided automatically when blocking actively, but visibility is reduced when the block button is held down.
The focus input has been disabled, made redundant by the improved blocking input.
Companions and enemies in shield walls now raise their shields naturally.
Improved behaviour of enemies in shield walls and AI pathfinding in general to prevent them from getting stuck.
You can now bring companions into Snorri's boss fight, and he has companions of his own.
The "Proceed" UI can now be opened and closed freely after the encounter has been cleared.
Injury icons are now diamonds rather than squares.

I am very happy to announce that in two weeks I will be working on Hammerheart full time, giving me the opportunity to release content and respond to feedback at a greater rate. Thank you very much to everyone has supported the project by playing and by leaving positive reviews. Stay tuned for more updates coming soon!

notes.title: Early Access Build 21.09.14.1
notes.content:
The latest Hammerheart patch aims to give more information to players and provide a smoother experience, especially to newer players. This is one of many updates that will come, improving upon parts of the UI.

Changes in build 21.09.14.1:


Remade the system for proceeding upon clearing an encounter. After you have recieved your rewards and managed your inventory, press TAB to view your reward options for the next encounter, with artwork and text descriptions.
Improved early game flow by giving the player medical items as the reward for the first encounter after the tutorial, and increased randomness of the second. 
Increased impact of the Ironside and Leechbook perks.
Lowered difficulty of the two enemies in the tutorial to improve first impressions; for more challenging practice, try the training mode.
Added a release buffer to the mouse buttons, helping to prevent some annoying isssues related to blocking and command mode with certain mouse models. This is planned to be customizeable when control settings come out.

Thank you everyone for your continued support and feedback, and special thanks to those of you who have left a positive review. It really means a lot! Many more changes and features to come in the future.

notes.title: Early Access Build 21.09.09.2
notes.content:
Important: This update will clear all saved dialogue and tutorials.

Hammerheart is a challenging game; this has been a point in the majority of feedback we've recieved in one way or another. This has been something we've been working on for a while, but results from internal testing with developers and experienced testers were inevitably skewed compared to those from the diverse range of players that have encountered Hammerheart upon its release. The latest build contains some new mechanics, changes and fixes aimed at helping new players learn the game, and widening the range of players that will be able to pick up and enjoy Hammerheart.

Changes in 21.09.09.2:


Added an infinite 1v1 training mode in which you can fight alone against infinite waves of singular enemies. This is useful for practicing blocking in an isolated environment.
Added perks. When you start a run, you can choose a perk to help you with certain aspects of Hammerheart. These are fairly utilitarian for now, but we have some cool ideas to add more flavour and variety in the future.
Ironside: Increased total health for you and your companions, improving your chances of making it out of an encounter alive.
Leechbook: Decreased chance of you or your companions sustaining injuries, allowing more focus to be placed on building and equipping your party.
No perk: The classic, punishing Hammerheart experience.
Improved the first tutorial to help players better understand the focus mechanic.
Changed "forget tutorials" setting to "forget save data" setting. This now clears dialogue progress as well. 
Added "quick restart" option to the pause menu and death screen.
Added a title and stats to the death screen, similar to the victory screen.
Reworked all painkillers.
Fixed Wiglaf turning bald upon removing his helmet.
Fixed pain immunity not saving across encounters for the Player.

Many more updates and content to come throughout the course of Early Access. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Early Access Build 21.09.07.3
notes.content:
Thanks everybody for a very successful first day! Releasing to a large audience of players has brought up several factors that were not apparent in playtesting, and after reading feedback and having conversations with players, some short-term plans have been drawn to improve the pace and sense of progression throughout a run. This is on our roadmap which can be viewed here. Today's build includes several changes working towards this plan.

Changes in 21.09.07.3:


Removed levy troop system and given the player 7 companions by default.
Wiglaf is now a permanent companion and his helmet is an inventory item.
Reduced chance of companions sustaining injuries.
Reduced amount by which a companion's block success is determined by the player's, and increased their base block success rate.
Increased amount of companions, weapons and meds awarded per encounter.
Reduced total amount of encounters and increased the intensity of the latter half.
Signified the more intense encounters by setting the surrounding buildings on fire.
If the fighting tutorial has been complete, the first 1v1 encounter is skipped in subsequent plays.
Removed the "sent home" mechanic from meds, and added a "causes septic wound" mechanic to some.
Removed Snorri's companions (we'll bring them back for a later boss...)

These changes are intended to increase the variety of situations the player might find themselves in and add more weight to decisions made. The progress that the player makes throughout a run should now be more apparent and feel more rewarding. This is the first update of many to come, and your feedback is always welcome. If you have any suggestions or feedback, please chat with us on our discord here.
